Tiny habits that
make you wiser every day
Ask "what can I learn from this?" after every mistake. It turns bad days into lessons and stops you from making the same mistake twice.
Read one page of philosophy each morning. Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, Epictetus. Old wisdom gives calm perspective on modern problems.
Talk to someone older every week. Grandparents, mentors, older colleagues. Their experience can save you years of trial and error.
Pause before reacting. Count to three before answering an angry message. Wisdom is often just the space between feeling and acting.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Understanding the past helps you make better choices today.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Understanding the past helps you make better choices today.

slides.texte_overlay: Keep a list of lessons learned. Every time life teaches you something, write it down. Re-read it once a month. Patterns will appear.
Spend time in silence. A walk without headphones, ten minutes without your phone. Clear thoughts need quiet space to appear.
